site_settings.welcome_heading: To The Two People Who Mean The World To Us
site_settings.cake_message_subtitle: May your love continue to grow stronger with every passing year.
site_settings.surprise_message:
Dear Mom and Dad,

Everything we are today is because of everything you have done for us.
Your sacrifices, guidance, patience and unconditional love have made our lives beautiful.
You are our greatest blessing and our forever heroes.
Thank you for being our parents.
We love you endlessly.

HAPPY WEDDING ANNIVERSARY! ❤️

timeline_events.title: The Sacred Vows
timeline_events.description: The blessed day two souls united with sacred rituals, bright smiles, blessings from family, and the beginning of a lifelong promise to walk hand in hand through every joy and sorrow.

timeline_events.title: Welcoming Our First Miracle
timeline_events.description: Their first journey into parenthood began. Sleepless nights turned into tender lullabies, and their home filled with the sound of laughter and little footsteps.

timeline_events.title: Building Our Family Nest
timeline_events.description: Through tireless hard work, perseverance and sacrifices, they built our warm family home—a sanctuary where unconditional love was always present at the dining table.

timeline_events.title: Unforgettable Family Journeys
timeline_events.description: Traveling across misty mountains and peaceful shorelines. What mattered was never the destination, but the warm comfort of being together as one tight-knit family.

timeline_events.title: Fifteen Crystal Years
timeline_events.description: Fifteen magnificent years of unwavering devotion, patience, and companionship celebrated surrounded by cherished relatives and proud children.

timeline_events.title: Twenty Years: Today, Tomorrow, Always
timeline_events.description: Today we celebrate two full decades of your boundless devotion. Twenty years of love that remains our compass, our inspiration, and our greatest blessing.

letters.author: From Your Eldest Son
letters.title: To My Greatest Teachers & Guiding Stars
letters.message:
Dear Amma & Abba,

Growing up, I watched how you handled every trial with dignity and gentleness. Dad, your calm resilience taught me how to stand firm in this world. Mom, your silent sacrifices and soothing prayers shielded us from every storm.

Whenever I feel uncertain, I simply look at the life you two built from the ground up with mutual respect and unwavering faith. Thank you for never giving up on our dreams, even when it meant putting yours on pause. May Allah grant you endless good health and joy together. Happy 20th Anniversary!

letters.author: From Your Daughter
letters.title: To The Best Mom & Dad in the Entire World
letters.message:
My darling Mom and Dad,

When people ask me what true love looks like, I always describe the two of you. The way Dad still brings Mom her favorite flowers, the way Mom knows what Dad needs before he even speaks a word.

You gave us not just a roof over our heads, but wings to fly and a sanctuary of unconditional tenderness to return to whenever life is heavy. Today is a celebration of your magical 20-year bond. We promise to cherish and protect the legacy of love you gifted us every single day. I love you both beyond words! ❤️

letters.author: From Your Youngest
letters.title: Our Forever Superheroes
letters.message:
Dearest Mom & Dad,

Thank you for every bedtime hug, every encouraging word before big exams, and every warm cup of chai shared on the balcony. You made our childhood feel like a fairytale.

Seeing your smile today is the greatest gift we could ever ask for. Happy 20th Wedding Anniversary to the coolest, most loving parents in the universe! Here's to many more decades of love, travel, and laughter!
